# Cases where the default mode deliberately differs from juice 12.1.3,
# on top of testdata/skip/juice-12.txt: juice disagrees with how browsers
# read the CSS, and the default follows the browser. CompatibilityMode(Juice12)
# keeps juice's behaviour and is checked against the same goldens without
# these lines.
# Format: <variant>/<fixture>  <reason>, or */<fixture> for every variant.
*/css-inline-suite/benchmarks/big_email_1  <style media="..."> applies only where its query matches, so it is left as written rather than inlined for everyone
*/style-tags/media-lists  <style media="..."> applies only where its query matches, so it is left as written rather than inlined for everyone
*/style-tags/media-matching  <style media="..."> applies only where its query matches, so it is left as written rather than inlined for everyone
*/style-tags/media-query  <style media="..."> applies only where its query matches, so it is left as written rather than inlined for everyone
*/cascade/pseudo-class-specificity  pseudo-classes score as classes, as CSS scores them, where juice scores them as types
*/cascade/selector-list-ties  pseudo-classes score as classes, as CSS scores them, so :only-child outranks td and writes its declarations after it
*/juice-suite/inline-content/pseudo-specificity  pseudo-classes score as classes, as CSS scores them, where juice scores them as types
no-css-variables/variables/basic  pseudo-classes score as classes, so :root outranks a type and its custom properties come after the element's own declarations
no-css-variables/variables/function-name  pseudo-classes score as classes, so :root outranks a type and its custom properties come after the element's own declarations
no-css-variables/variables/in-shorthand  pseudo-classes score as classes, so :root outranks a type and its custom properties come after the element's own declarations
no-css-variables/variables/nested  pseudo-classes score as classes, so :root outranks a type and its custom properties come after the element's own declarations
*/css-inline-suite/tests/remove_inlined_selectors_ends_unterminated_at_rules_with_their_block  each <style> block is its own stylesheet, as in browsers; juice joins them, so an unclosed at-rule swallows the next block's rules
inline-pseudo-elements/serialization/style-in-string  each <style> block is its own stylesheet, as in browsers; juice joins them with newlines, so a string left open at the end of the last one takes in a "\n"
*/premailer-suite/misc/commented_out_styles_in_the_body  CSS ignores <!-- and --> in a stylesheet, so browsers apply the rule; juice reads "<!-- p" as a selector and applies nothing
*/pseudo-elements/content-markup  pseudo-element content is text, as browsers show it, so markup and "&" in a content string are escaped; juice writes them into the document as HTML
*/pseudo-elements/trailing-combinator  pseudo-element content is text, as browsers show it, so content:">" is written &gt;; juice writes it raw
*/juice-suite/juice-content/pseudo-elements  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a:first-child does not match an <a> after one; juice removes them first
*/juice-suite/juice-content/pseudo-elements-and-width-attr  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a:first-child does not match an <a> after one; juice removes them first
default/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
inline-pseudo-elements/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
no-attributes/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
no-css-variables/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
no-preserve/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
preserve-important/style-tags/first-child  <style> elements stay in the tree until selectors have matched, as in browsers, so a <p> after one is not :first-child; juice removes them first
*/l4-spec/attr-unquoted  a rule whose selector browsers reject is not inlined: [width=600] needs its value quoted, as 600 is not an identifier
*/l4-spec/universal-type  a rule whose selector browsers reject is not inlined: "*a" puts a type selector after *
*/l4-spec/dangling-combinator  a rule whose selector browsers reject is not inlined: a combinator with nothing after it, or in :not() with nothing before it
*/nesting/dangling-combinator  a rule whose selector browsers reject is not inlined, nested rules included: "p+" ends in a combinator
inline-pseudo-elements/pseudo-elements/not-last  a rule whose selector browsers reject is not inlined: ".a:after+" ends in a combinator
*/ignore/pseudo-and-semicolon  a rule after a stray ";" is not inlined, as browsers read the ";" as part of its selector and reject it
*/malformed/stray-closing-bracket  a declaration with stray text before its property, such as ")", is dropped, as browsers drop it
*/nesting/stray-paren  a declaration with stray text before its property, such as ")", is dropped, as browsers drop it
*/malformed/leading-colon  a declaration with stray text before its property, such as ":", is dropped, as browsers drop it
*/malformed/unclosed-double-quote  a string left open runs to the end of the stylesheet, as in browsers, taking in the rules after it; postcss ends it after one character
*/malformed/unclosed-quote  a string left open runs to the end of the stylesheet, as in browsers, taking in the rules after it; postcss ends it after one character
inline-pseudo-elements/nesting/unclosed-quote  a string left open runs to the end of the stylesheet, as in browsers, taking in the rules after it; postcss ends it after one character
*/nesting/top-level-amp-document  a top-level & is :scope, the root element, as in browsers; juice never matches it
